name: Frontify Integration
description: Integrates the Frontify digital-asset-management (DAM) platform with Drupal media.
project_description:
This module integrates Drupal with the Frontify digital asset management (DAM) platform.

Use this module to import/upload media from your Frontify digital asset management system.

 More in-depth, this module includes

 
 Deep integration with Frontify’s asset management system 
 Ability to link Frontify to specific image fields on your Drupal site. The Frontify integration can coexist with other file and image storage solutions. 
 Select assets from Frontify in your Drupal image fields or WYSIWYG editors using the Frontify Media Browser called ‘‘Frontify Finder’ 
 Frontify Finder is a component that wraps up client authentication and asset management in a single flow, decoupled from the main Frontify application, allowing your assets stored in Frontify to be easily included in any web application. 
 Provides common search and filtering options out of the box

Context-aware, so the browser respects your Drupal configuration for things like allowed file types/extensions, min/max resolution, required selections, default images, etc.
